title: LLMs Threaten Online Survey Research
body: An AI respondent passed 99.8% of attention checks, costs about 5 cents a survey, and can skew results on command.
credit: Majed A. Arishi and Rui Jin

title: What 81,000 People Want from AI
body: Claude interviewed 80,508 users in 159 countries: the top hope was professional excellence; the top fear, unreliability.

title: LLMs Misportray and Flatten Identities
body: Compared with 3,200 people across 16 identities, LLM personas gave stereotyped, flatter, less diverse answers.
